description: Create a new item on a board, optionally in a group and with initial column values.

board_id.description: The board id the item belongs to.

item_name.description: The name of the new item.

group_id.description: Optional group id; defaults to the board's first group.

column_values.description: Optional mapping of column_id to a value or {text, value} object.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created item view; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update an item's group and/or a single column value.

item_id.description: The unique id of the item to update.

text.description: Optional display text for the column value.

value.description: Optional raw value for the column value.

group_id.description: Optional new group id for the item.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated item view; on failure, output contains an error message.
